It wasn't due to happen, though, because there were some technical problems, so it has been pushed back.
Instead, the launch is to take place at 11.18am GMT on 6 January.
To do this, the Falcon 9 rocket was to launch a Dragon spacecraft to deliver supplies to the International Space Station.
Once the Dragon spacecraft had returned the rocket is supposed to attempt to land after it came down from space.
If successful, it will become the first ever attempt at doing this and the aim is for the company to eventually be able to reuse its rockets.

sentences.sentence: More than 450,000 Pakistanis have fled their homes for safer areas in the past two weeks as the military has attacked suspected anti-government militant hideouts in northwestern Pakistan, disaster management officials said Tuesday.

Many of the displaced civilians have moved to other districts within the North Waziristan area but around 26,000 of them are staying with friends and family outside North Waziristan, a spokesman for the UN High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) told reporters on Wednesday.

In the past two weeks, airstrikes against militant hideouts have resulted in more than 250 insurgents being killed, the army has said, while the Pakistani Taliban has admitted that some of its men are among those who have been killed.
According to the army, the air strikes were launched against areas where there has been fighting between the Pakistani Taliban, al-Qaeda and other militant groups.

North Waziristan, an area of over 8,200 square kilometers, is situated just to the east of the North and South Waziristan, which are also part of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas, FATA, region.
The FATA region is not under provincial or federal control.
It should be noted that the army is not targeting women, children, the old and the disabled.
However, in a news conference, a senior Pakistani security official explained that the air strikes were necessary, saying: "It's a very important target, the enemy is hiding in these caves."

A spokesman from the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) said, "We've seen the conditions of many of the internally displaced people we have met, and they're terrible, it's hard for us to describe what these poor people have gone through.
They lost everything, they've left behind their homes, their animals, their fields.
They don't know how long this is going to take."
